name: Astronoma
author: John Kerr
description: A local flight log for Omarchy updates: releases crossed, package changes, migrations, warnings, and optional safe agent summaries.

barWidget.description: Keeps a rocket in the bar, accent-coloured while an update you have not read is waiting. Click for the summary, or open the full flight log.

schema.label: Show in bar
schema.description: 'always' keeps the rocket in the bar, accent-coloured while an update you have not opened is waiting. 'unread' is quieter: the rocket appears only while such an update is waiting, and leaves the bar once you have read it.
